Альфа-липоевая кислота.about: Antioxidant and coenzyme: sensory symptoms of diabetic polyneuropathy are lower; Doesn't help you lose weight.
Альфа-липоевая кислота.caution: Alpha lipoic acid (ALA) is an antioxidant. For diabetic peripheral neuropathy: A Cochrane review supports efficacy (600 mg/day IV or PO). For cardiometabolic factors: data available. For weight: the effect is small. For the liver (MASLD): data available. For fertility: limited data. Safe in doses of 300-600 mg/day. Caution: diabetes (reduce sugar, adjust insulin dose).
effects: Neuropathy: moderate; weight loss - no (not confirmed)
Альфа-липоевая кислота.food_sources: Liver, spinach, broccoli: ALA in bound form - the 600 mg studied cannot be obtained from food.
Альфа-липоевая кислота.guidelines: MA 2023 (10 RCT, 1242): sensory symptoms lower, dose-dependent; Cochrane 2024 (816) showed no benefit after 6 months.
Альфа-липоевая кислота.how_to_choose: 600 mg/day – research dose; higher only with a doctor; in case of diabetes, adjust glucose-lowering medications.
mechs: Reducing oxidative stress and improving nerve fiber microcirculation
Sensory symptoms of diabetic polyneuropathy are lower, dose-dependent (10 RCT, 1242 people)
Claimed disease-modifying effect in diabetic neuropathy
Cochrane review 2024: small/not significant effect on symptoms at 6 months (3 RCT, 816 people)
Альфа-липоевая кислота.myths: “Cures neuropathy” - Cochrane 2024 for 6 months there is almost no effect, improvement only in sensory symptoms (MA 2023). “Burns fat” - no effect.
Альфа-липоевая кислота.name: Alpha-Lipoic Acid
Альфа-липоевая кислота.onset: Effect over a distance of weeks (600–1800 mg/day); Cochrane 2024 sees no benefit for 6 months.
Альфа-липоевая кислота.title: Alpha-Lipoic Acid
Альфа-липоевая кислота.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Альфа-липоевая кислота.who_needs: Diabetic polyneuropathy with sensory symptoms - under medical supervision, 600 mg/day; Don't rely on weight.
